var searchMonsterByIconMode = "";

var swgtSelectPickerLastAction = "";

<script type="text/javascript">
$(document).ready(function() {
	
	
	function_changeView('ALL');
	
	if(function_isTouchDevice() == false){
		$('.swgt-monster-tooltip').tooltipster({
			contentAsHTML: 'true',
			theme: 'tooltipster-shadow',
			position: 'right',
			content: 'Loading...',
			//autoClose: false,
			speed: 0,
		    functionBefore: function(origin, continueTooltip) {
		        continueTooltip();
		        
		    	origin.tooltipster('content', origin[0].dataset.viewelement);
		    }
		});
	}
});
function function_searchMonsters(){
	if($("#BTN_viewAll").hasClass("btn-primary"))
		function_changeView('ALL');
	if($("#BTN_viewHOH").hasClass("btn-primary"))
		function_changeView('HOH');
	if($("#BTN_viewFusion").hasClass("btn-primary"))
		function_changeView('FUSION');
}
function function_clearSearchMonsters(){
	$("#searchForMonster").val("");
	function_searchMonsters();
	$("#searchForMonster").focus();
}
function function_changeSkillFilter(skillFilter){
	$("#BTN_skillFilterAny").removeClass("btn-outline-primary");
	$("#BTN_skillFilterAny").removeClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
	$("#BTN_skillFilterAny").removeClass("btn-primary");
	
	$("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").removeClass("btn-outline-primary");
	$("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").removeClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
	$("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").removeClass("btn-primary");
	
	if(skillFilter == "ANY"){
		$("#BTN_skillFilterAny").addClass("btn-primary");
		
		$("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
		$("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
	}else{
		$("#BTN_skillFilterAny").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
		$("#BTN_skillFilterAny").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
		
		$("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").addClass("btn-primary");
	}
	function_searchMonsters();
}
function function_changeView(viewType){
	let countsByElement = new Map();
	countsByElement.set("Water",0);
	countsByElement.set("Fire",0);
	countsByElement.set("Wind",0);
	countsByElement.set("Light",0);
	countsByElement.set("Dark",0);
	
	let buttonWater = $("#BUTTON_filter_water").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonFire = $("#BUTTON_filter_fire").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonWind = $("#BUTTON_filter_wind").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonLight = $("#BUTTON_filter_light").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonDark = $("#BUTTON_filter_dark").hasClass("btn-primary");

	let buttonNAT1 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat1").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonNAT2 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat2").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonNAT3 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat3").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonNAT4 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat4").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let buttonNAT5 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat5").hasClass("btn-primary");

	let andSearchTags = new Set();
	
	let archetype = $("#archetype").val();
	if(archetype != "")
		andSearchTags.add(archetype);

	let leaderSkillStat = $("#leaderSkillStat").val();
	if(leaderSkillStat != "")
		andSearchTags.add(leaderSkillStat);
	
	let leaderSkillAreaTags = new Set();
	$("#leaderSkillArea :selected").each(function() {
		leaderSkillAreaTags.add($(this).val());
	});
	
	let collaboration = $("#collaboration :selected").val();
	if(collaboration != "")
		andSearchTags.add(collaboration);
	
	let skillFilterAny = $("#BTN_skillFilterAny").hasClass("btn-primary");
	let skillFilterSingle = $("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").hasClass("btn-primary");
	
	let skillFilterMode = (skillFilterAny ? "ANY":"SINGLE");
	
	let andSkillSearchTags = new Set();
	let cooldownTags = new Set();
	let hitTags = new Set();
	
	$("#beneficialEffects :selected").each(function() {
		andSkillSearchTags.add($(this).val());
	});
	$("#harmfulEffects :selected").each(function() {
		andSkillSearchTags.add($(this).val());
	});
	$("#otherEffects :selected").each(function() {
		andSkillSearchTags.add($(this).val());
	});
	$("#scalesWith :selected").each(function() {
		andSkillSearchTags.add($(this).val());
	});
	
	let passive = $("#passive").val();
	if(passive == "Y")
		andSkillSearchTags.add("hasPassive");
	if(passive == "N")
		andSkillSearchTags.add("noPassive");
	
	let aoe = $("#aoe").val();
	if(aoe == "Y")
		andSkillSearchTags.add("hasAOE");
	if(aoe == "N")
		andSkillSearchTags.add("noAOE");
	
	let minCooldown = $("#minCooldown :selected").val()*1;
	let maxCooldown = $("#maxCooldown :selected").val()*1;
	for(let c = 0; c <= 13; c++){
		if(c >= minCooldown && c <= maxCooldown)
			cooldownTags.add("cooldown"+c);
	}
	
	let minHits = $("#minHits :selected").val()*1;
	let maxHits = $("#maxHits :selected").val()*1;
	for(let h = 0; h <= 13; h++){
		if(h >= minHits && h <= maxHits)
			hitTags.add("hits"+h);
	}
	
	let input = $('#searchForMonster').val();
	if(input == null || input.length == 0){
		$("#BTN_clearMonsterSearch").hide();
	}else{
		$("#BTN_clearMonsterSearch").show();
	}
	
	$("#BTN_viewAll").removeClass("btn-primary");
	$("#BTN_viewAll").removeClass("btn-outline-primary");
	$("#BTN_viewAll").removeClass("swgt-btn-transparent");

	$("#BTN_viewHOH").removeClass("btn-primary");
	$("#BTN_viewHOH").removeClass("btn-outline-primary");
	$("#BTN_viewHOH").removeClass("swgt-btn-transparent");

	$("#BTN_viewFusion").removeClass("btn-primary");
	$("#BTN_viewFusion").removeClass("btn-outline-primary");
	$("#BTN_viewFusion").removeClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
	
	$('.swgt-monster-tile').each(function(){
		let monstername = $(this).data('monstername');
		
		let showFomInputBox = true;
		if (input.length > 0 && input != '') {
			try{
				input = input.toLowerCase();
			}catch(err) {}
		
			showFomInputBox = false;
			
			let monsterelement = $(this).data('monsterelement');
			let monsterunawakenedname = $(this).data('monsterunawakenedname');
			
			let totalSearchString = "";
			if(monstername)
				totalSearchString += " "+monstername;
			if(monsterelement)
				totalSearchString += " "+monsterelement;
			if(monsterunawakenedname)
				totalSearchString += " "+monsterunawakenedname;
			
			let conditions = input.split(/[\s,]+/);
			
			if(totalSearchString && conditions.reduce((a,c) => a + totalSearchString.toLowerCase().includes(c), 0) == conditions.length)
				showFomInputBox = true;
		}
		
		let isHOH = $(this).hasClass("isHOH");
		let isFusion = $(this).hasClass("isFusion");
		
		let monsterelement = $(this).data('monsterelement');
		let monsternaturalstars = $(this).data('monsternaturalstars');
		
		let showFromButtons = false;
		if(viewType == "ALL"){
			$("#BTN_viewAll").addClass("btn-primary");
			
			$("#BTN_viewHOH").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
			$("#BTN_viewHOH").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");

			$("#BTN_viewFusion").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
			$("#BTN_viewFusion").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
			
			showFromButtons = true;
		}
		if(viewType == "HOH"){
			$("#BTN_viewAll").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
			$("#BTN_viewAll").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
			
			$("#BTN_viewHOH").addClass("btn-primary");

			$("#BTN_viewFusion").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
			$("#BTN_viewFusion").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
			
			if(isHOH)
				showFromButtons = true;
		}

		if(viewType == "FUSION"){
			$("#BTN_viewAll").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
			$("#BTN_viewAll").addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
			
			$("#BTN_viewHOH").addClass("btn-outline-primary");
			$("#BTN_viewHOH").addClass("btn-outline-primary");

			$("#BTN_viewFusion").addClass("btn-primary");
			
			if(isFusion)
				showFromButtons = true;
		}
		
		if("Water" == monsterelement && buttonWater == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("Fire" == monsterelement && buttonFire == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("Wind" == monsterelement && buttonWind == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("Light" == monsterelement && buttonLight == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("Dark" == monsterelement && buttonDark == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		
		if("1" == monsternaturalstars && buttonNAT1 == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("2" == monsternaturalstars && buttonNAT2 == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("3" == monsternaturalstars && buttonNAT3 == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("4" == monsternaturalstars && buttonNAT4 == false)
			showFromButtons = false;
		if("5" == monsternaturalstars && buttonNAT5 == false)
			showFromButtons = false;

		let showFromAndSearchTags = false;
		if(andSearchTags.size > 0){
			showFromAndSearchTags = true;
			for (const searchTag of andSearchTags) {
				showFromAndSearchTags = $(this).hasClass(searchTag) && showFromAndSearchTags;
			}
		}else{
			showFromAndSearchTags = true;
		}
		
		let showFromLeaderSkillArea = false;
		if(leaderSkillAreaTags.size > 0){
			for(const searchTag of leaderSkillAreaTags){
				if($(this).hasClass(searchTag)){
					showFromLeaderSkillArea = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}else{
			showFromLeaderSkillArea = true;

		}
		
		if(skillFilterMode == "ANY"){
			let showFromAndSkillSearchTags = false;
			let showFromCooldownSearchTags = false;
			let showFromHitsSearchTags = false;
			
			if(andSkillSearchTags.size > 0){
				showFromAndSkillSearchTags = true;
				for (const searchTag of andSkillSearchTags) {
					showFromAndSkillSearchTags = $(this).hasClass(searchTag) && showFromAndSkillSearchTags;
				}
			}else{
				showFromAndSkillSearchTags = true;
			}
			if(cooldownTags.size > 0){
				for (const searchTag of cooldownTags) {
					showFromCooldownSearchTags = $(this).hasClass(searchTag) || showFromCooldownSearchTags;
				}
			}else{
				showFromCooldownSearchTags = true;
			}
			if(hitTags.size > 0){
				for (const searchTag of hitTags) {
					showFromHitsSearchTags = $(this).hasClass(searchTag) || showFromHitsSearchTags;
				}
			}else{
				showFromHitsSearchTags = true;
			}
			
			if(showFomInputBox && showFromButtons && showFromAndSearchTags && showFromLeaderSkillArea && showFromAndSkillSearchTags && showFromCooldownSearchTags && showFromHitsSearchTags){
				$(this).show();
				
				countsByElement.set(monsterelement,countsByElement.get(monsterelement)+1);
			}else{
				$(this).hide();
			}
		}else{
			let skillDataElements = new Set();
			skillDataElements.add("skill1searchtags");
			skillDataElements.add("skill2searchtags");
			skillDataElements.add("skill3searchtags");
			skillDataElements.add("skill4searchtags");
			
			let showFromSkills = false;
			for(const skillDataElementKey of skillDataElements){
				let skillDataElement = $(this).data(skillDataElementKey);
				
				if(skillDataElement == null && skillDataElement == "")
					continue;
				
				let showFromAndSkillSearchTags = function_stringHasElements(skillDataElement,andSkillSearchTags,"AND");
				let showFromCooldownSearchTags = function_stringHasElements(skillDataElement,cooldownTags,"OR");
				let showFromHitsSearchTags = function_stringHasElements(skillDataElement,hitTags,"OR");
				
				if(showFromAndSkillSearchTags && showFromCooldownSearchTags && showFromHitsSearchTags)
					showFromSkills = true;
			}
			
			if(showFomInputBox && showFromButtons && showFromAndSearchTags && showFromLeaderSkillArea && showFromSkills){
				$(this).show();
				
				countsByElement.set(monsterelement,countsByElement.get(monsterelement)+1);
			}else{
				$(this).hide();
			}
		}
	});
	
	
	let outMonsterCounts = "";
	
	countsByElement.forEach (function(value, key) {
		outMonsterCounts += "<div class=\"mr-4 d-inline-block\"><img class='rounded monster-image-18 mr-1' src='https://do9d4mpqk497d.cloudfront.net/common/images/elements/"+key.toLowerCase()+".png'/>x"+value+"</div>";
	});
	
	$("#DIV_monsterCounts").html(outMonsterCounts);
}
function function_toggleButtonFilter(id){
	if($("#"+id).hasClass("btn-outline-primary")){
		$("#"+id).removeClass("btn-outline-primary");
		$("#"+id).removeClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
		$("#"+id).addClass("btn-primary");
	}else{
		$("#"+id).removeClass("btn-primary");
		$("#"+id).addClass("btn-outline-primary");
		$("#"+id).addClass("swgt-btn-transparent");
	}
	$("#"+id).blur();
	
	if($("#BTN_viewAll").hasClass("btn-primary"))
		function_changeView('ALL');
	if($("#BTN_viewHOH").hasClass("btn-primary"))
		function_changeView('HOH');
	if($("#BTN_viewFusion").hasClass("btn-primary"))
		function_changeView('FUSION');
}
function function_changeSortBy(sortBy){
	var viewAll = $("#BTN_viewAll").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var viewHOH = $("#BTN_viewHOH").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var viewFusion = $("#BTN_viewFusion").hasClass("btn-primary");
	
	var buttonWater = $("#BUTTON_filter_water").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonFire = $("#BUTTON_filter_fire").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonWind = $("#BUTTON_filter_wind").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonLight = $("#BUTTON_filter_light").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonDark = $("#BUTTON_filter_dark").hasClass("btn-primary");

	var buttonNAT1 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat1").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonNAT2 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat2").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonNAT3 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat3").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonNAT4 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat4").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var buttonNAT5 = $("#BUTTON_filter_nat5").hasClass("btn-primary");
	
	var skillFilterAny = $("#BTN_skillFilterAny").hasClass("btn-primary");
	var skillFilterSingle = $("#BTN_skillFilterSingle").hasClass("btn-primary");
	
	var url = "/controllers/tools/monsterCatalog";
	
	url += "?sortBy="+sortBy;

	url += "&displayAs=GRID";
	
	if(viewAll)
		url += "&view=ALL";
	if(viewHOH)
		url += "&view=HOH";
	if(viewFusion)
		url += "&view=FUSION";
	
	url += "&water="+(buttonWater?"Y":"N");
	url += "&fire="+(buttonFire?"Y":"N");
	url += "&wind="+(buttonWind?"Y":"N");
	url += "&light="+(buttonLight?"Y":"N");
	url += "&dark="+(buttonDark?"Y":"N");
	
	url += "&nat1="+(buttonNAT1?"Y":"N");
	url += "&nat2="+(buttonNAT2?"Y":"N");
	url += "&nat3="+(buttonNAT3?"Y":"N");
	url += "&nat4="+(buttonNAT4?"Y":"N");
	url += "&nat5="+(buttonNAT5?"Y":"N");
	
	var archetype = $("#archetype").val();
	if(archetype != "")
		url += "&archetype="+archetype;

	var leaderSkillStat = $("#leaderSkillStat").val();
	if(leaderSkillStat != "")
		url += "&leaderSkillStat="+leaderSkillStat;
	
	$("#leaderSkillArea :selected").each(function() {
		url += "&leaderSkillArea="+encodeURIComponent($(this).val());
	});
	
	$("#beneficialEffects :selected").each(function() {
		url += "&bEff="+$(this).val();
	});
	$("#harmfulEffects :selected").each(function() {
		url += "&hEff="+$(this).val();
	});
	$("#otherEffects :selected").each(function() {
		url += "&oEff="+$(this).val();
	});
	
	url += "&passive="+$("#passive").val();
	url += "&aoe="+$("#aoe").val();
	
	url += "&minCooldown="+($("#minCooldown :selected").val()*1);
	url += "&maxCooldown="+($("#maxCooldown :selected").val()*1);

	url += "&minHits="+($("#minHits :selected").val()*1);
	url += "&maxHits="+($("#maxHits :selected").val()*1);
	
	$("#scalesWith :selected").each(function() {
		url += "&scalesWith="+$(this).val();
	});

	if(skillFilterAny)
		url += "&skillFilter=ANY";
	if(skillFilterSingle)
		url += "&skillFilter=SINGLE";
	
	var collaboration = $("#collaboration").val();
	if(collaboration != "")
		url += "&collaboration="+collaboration;
	
	window.location=url;
}
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
function function_common_modal_alert(alertMessage){
	BootstrapDialog.show({
		animate: false,
		title: 'Alert',
		type: BootstrapDialog.TYPE_DANGER,
        message: alertMessage,
        onshow: function(dialog) {
        	document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]').content = 'width=device-width, minimum-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, initial-scale=1.0';
        },
        onhide: function(dialog) {
        	document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]').content = 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1';
        },
		buttons: [
            {
            	label: 'OK',
            	cssClass: 'btn-sm btn-systemDefault',
            	action: function(dialogItself){
                	dialogItself.close();
            	}
        	}
        ]
    });
}
</script>







<script type="text/javascript">
function function_common_modal_message(title,message){
	BootstrapDialog.show({
		animate: false,
		title: title,
        message: message,
        onshow: function(dialog) {
        	document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]').content = 'width=device-width, minimum-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, initial-scale=1.0';
        },
        onhide: function(dialog) {
        	document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]').content = 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1';
        },
		buttons: [
            {
            	label: 'OK',
            	cssClass: 'btn-sm btn-systemDefault',
            	action: function(dialogItself){
                	dialogItself.close();
            	}
        	}
        ]
    });
}
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
$( document ).ready(function() {
	
	
	$('form').attr('autocomplete','off');
	
	$(document).on('hidden.bs.modal', '.modal', function () {
        $('.modal:visible').length && $(document.body).addClass('modal-open');
    });
    
    var offset = 220;
    var duration = 500;
    $(window).scroll(function() {
        if (jQuery(this).scrollTop() > offset) {
            $('.back-to-top').fadeIn(duration);
        } else {
            $('.back-to-top').fadeOut(duration);
        }
    });
    
    $('.back-to-top').click(function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        $('html, body').animate({scrollTop: 0}, duration);
        return false;
    });
    
    observeSWGTLazyLoad();
    
    //Handle any datatables page changes
    $(document).on('draw.dt', function (e) {
    	observeSWGTLazyLoad(e.target);
  	});
    $(document).on('shown.bs.modal', '.modal', function () {
        observeSWGTLazyLoad(this);
    });
    
    swgtSyncFloatingHeaders();

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        swgtSyncFloatingHeaders();
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
    });

    $(document).on('draw.dt', swgtSyncFloatingHeaders);
    $(window).on('scroll resize', swgtSyncFloatingHeaders);
    
 	// Datatables in tabs cleanup
    $(document).on('shown.bs.tab', 'a[data-toggle="tab"], button[data-toggle="tab"]', function () {
    	swgtFixDataTablesLayout();
    });

    var swgtDtResizeTimer;
    $(window).on('resize', function () {
    	clearTimeout(swgtDtResizeTimer);
    	swgtDtResizeTimer = setTimeout(swgtFixDataTablesLayout, 150);
    });
});
</script>
